sloka: मलयेन च विन्ध्येन मेरुणा मन्दरेण च ।दर्दुरेण च ते देवि शपे मूलफलेन च ।। ५.३६.३८।।।।
transliteration: malayena ca vindhyena meruṇā mandareṇa ca ।dardureṇa ca te devi śape mūlaphalena ca ।। 5.36.38।।।।

translations.english: "O Sita I swear in the name of mountains like Malaya, Vindhya, Meru, and Dardura (the abodes of monkeys and bears) and by the roots and fruits as well (which are the food of vanaras). you will soon behold Rama with beautiful eyes, red lips like bimba fruit, lovely earrings and a countenance resembling the full moon.
translations.hindi: उस कौए ने ग्रपनी दाहिनी श्राँख गेंवा ग्रपने प्राण बचाए श्रौर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी तथा महाराज दशरथजी को प्रणाम कर ग्रौर बिदा माँग अपने चर चला गया । (हे हनुमान ! तुम उनसे कहना कि) आपने मेरे पीछे तो एक कौए पर ब्रह्मास्त्र चलाया था
